phase: Phase 22: Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) & Dynamic RF Airtime QoS Throttle

stories.title: Pure KMP Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) Engine & Multi-Tier Codec Scaling
stories.description: Implement pure KMP BitrateProfileModels.kt and AdaptiveBitrateEngine.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/audio/codec/. Defines dynamic audio compression tiers (HQ_WIDEBAND 32kbps/16kHz, STANDARD_CONVOY 16kbps/8kHz, NARROWBAND_FALLBACK 8kbps/8kHz, EMERGENCY_RESCUE 4kbps with parity forward error correction). Dynamically tracks moving-window Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) and peer link RSSI, shifting codec bitrate up or down without audible clicking or buffer underrun. 100% pure Kotlin with 0 Java/C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or platform-specific dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Defines BitrateTier enum (HQ_WIDEBAND, STANDARD_CONVOY, NARROWBAND_FALLBACK, EMERGENCY_RESCUE)
Dynamically downscales bitrate when PDR drops below 85% or link RSSI degrades below -85 dBm
Dynamically upscales bitrate with hysteresis to prevent rapid flapping under variable RF conditions
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Pure KMP Priority Voice QoS Traffic Scheduler & Preemption Arbiter
stories.description: Implement QoSModels.kt and PriorityQoSQueue.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/qos/. Implements multi-tier priority traffic shaper: Priority 0 (EMERGENCY_SOS / CRASH_IMPACT) with unconditional preemption, Priority 1 (ACTIVE_PTT_VOICE) with bounded 20ms jitter budget, Priority 2 (ROUTING_CONTROL) for AODV route discovery and keep-alives, and Priority 3 (TELEMETRY_AND_FILES) for GPX route chunks and background GPS beacons. Throttles Priority 3 background traffic during active voice transmissions to prevent 2.4GHz BLE airtime contention.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements strict priority dequeuing with starving prevention for control packets
Unconditionally preempts low-priority telemetry when voice or emergency SOS frames are queued
Dynamically throttles non-urgent packet generation during high channel utilization
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Hardware Bridge Wiring & Multiplatform ABR/QoS HUD Integration
stories.description: Wire AdaptiveBitrateEngine and PriorityQoSQueue into IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers. Expose reactive QoSSnapshot (active bitrate tier, packet loss percentage, link headroom, queued packet count). Present ABR/QoS metric pill and channel health sheet in Compose Multiplatform (HomeScreen.kt) and 100% Native iOS SwiftUI (ContentView.swift / IntercomViewModel.swift respecting Rule 1).
acceptanceCriteria: Hardware bridges expose QoSSnapshot flow and reactive CancellationHandle observers for iOS (Rule 1)
Compose Multiplatform displays active ABR pill (32k/16k/8k) and RF channel headroom meter
100% Native iOS SwiftUI displays tactical ABR/QoS badge in avionics bar (Rule 1)
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets

stories.title: 32-Node Congested RF Mesh ABR & QoS Simulation Harness & Archify Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement CongestedMeshQoSSimulationHarness.kt simulating a 32-node large convoy under 40% RF contention and heavy background GPX route beaming. Validates that dynamic ABR down-stepping and QoS voice preemption maintain >90% voice intelligibility and <120ms latency despite heavy RF airtime load. Update Archify interactive architecture specifications to showcase quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 32 nodes under heavy RF contention and background data transfers
Demonstrates automatic codec bitrate downscaling under packet loss conditions
Validates voice preemption over background GPX telemetry with zero voice starvation
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification pass
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets
